# POST /api/v1/orgs/{org}/actions/runners/registration-token

Get an organization's actions runner registration token

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-042`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — RegistrationToken

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `token` | string | Registration token string for runner registration |

- **404** — Organization does not exist
- **403** — User is not org owner or site admin
- **500** — Internal error creating/fetching token

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Organization ownership required for all actions endpoints (secrets, variables, runners) | authorization | User is not org owner AND not site admin |
| Registration token reuses existing active token if available | business_logic | Latest token exists AND is active |
| Creating new runner token deactivates all existing tokens for same owner/repo | business_logic | New token is being created |

## Error Handling

| Database failure on insert/select | 500 | internal error | True |
